{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=normal| trainername=Norman| pokemonname=Slaking| jtrainername=センリ| jpokemonname=ケッキング| tmtrainername=Senri| tmpokemonname=Kekking| image=[[File:Norman Slaking.png|215px]] | caption=Norman's Slaking in {{aniseries|RS}} | location=[[Hoenn]] | gender=Unknown{{tt|*|Confirmed male in games only}}| nature=Sassy{{tt|*|Confirmed in Pokémon Adventures only}} | ability={{a|Truant}}{{tt|*|Confirmed in the games and Pokémon Adventures only}} | epnum=AG069| epname=Love, Petalburg Style!| prevonum=289| noevo=incap | current=[[Party|With Norman]]| java1=[[Unshō Ishizuka]]| enva1=[[Dan Green]]| }} '''Norman's Slaking''' (Japanese: '''センリのケッキング''' ''Senri's Kekking'') is [[Norman]]'s main {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}} and his most powerful Pokémon. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|AG}}==== [[File:AG070.png|thumb|220px|left|Slaking battling Ash's Grovyle]] Slaking debuted in ''[[AG069|Love, Petalburg Style!]]'', where it was staying in Norman's greenhouse with the rest of his Pokémon. It slept throughout the majority of the episode. Later, when {{TRT}} destroyed a fireworks machine that Norman was keeping for his wedding anniversary, he flew into a rage and thus summoned {{p|Slaking}} from inside the greenhouse. On Norman's command, it charged at the terrified trio and violently sent them blasting off with a powerful {{m|Focus Punch}}. Norman later used it in his [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} against {{Ash}} in ''[[AG070|Balance of Power]]'', where it demonstrated itself as a powerful fighter. With its brute strength, it almost defeated [[Ash's Grovyle]]. However, when Grovyle's {{a|Overgrow}} [[Ability]] activated, it managed to gain the upper hand and Slaking was defeated. [[File:Norman Slaking DP.png|thumb|220px|Slaking and Norman in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'']] It reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[AG075|Whiscash and Ash]]'' and ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]. In ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]'', Slaking watched May as she competed in the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]] on [[television]]. ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== Slaking was being groomed by [[Max]] in one of {{an|May}}'s flashbacks in ''[[DP076|A Full Course Tag Battle!]]''. In ''[[DP079|Strategy With a Smile!]]'', it watched the final round between May and {{an|Dawn}} during the [[Wallace Cup]], with Max, Norman, and [[Caroline]]. ===Personality and characteristics=== Unlike most Slaking, this Slaking appears to be very lively and active. This was shown when Norman called it over in order to send Team Rocket flying and during the Gym battle against Ash's Grovyle. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|normal||Norman Slaking {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Focus Punch|1=Earthquake|2=Hyper Beam}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Focus Punch|1=Earthquake|2=Hyper Beam}}}} {{anmov|fighting|Focus Punch|AG069|Love, Petalburg Style!}} {{anmov|ground|Earthquake|AG070|Balance of Power}} {{anmov|normal|Hyper Beam|AG070|Balance of Power}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ===Pokémon Masters Animated Trailer=== {{main|Norman (Masters)#In animation|Norman (Masters) → In animation}} In the [[Pokémon Masters Animated Trailer]], Norman's Slaking was part of a team with its {{pkmn|Trainer}} and {{ga|Brendan}}. ===GOTCHA!=== Norman's Slaking briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. {{-}} ==In the games== Like in {{aniseries|PTS}}, Slaking is Norman's main Pokémon in the games as well. ''Chapter 07''}} |} ==In the manga== ===Ash & Pikachu=== [[File:Norman Slaking AP.png|thumb|200px|Slaking in Ash & Pikachu]] Slaking appeared in ''[[SP25|I'll Win With My Own Battle Style!!]]'', where Norman sent it out to battle [[Ash's Grovyle]]. {{sectionstub}} ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|normal||Norman Slaking {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Focus Punch|1=Earthquake|2=Hyper Beam}} AP.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Focus Punch|1=Earthquake|2=Hyper Beam}}}} {{anmov|fighting|Focus Punch|SP25|I'll Win With My Own Battle Style!!}} {{anmov|ground|Earthquake|SP25|I'll Win With My Own Battle Style!!}} {{anmov|normal|Hyper Beam|SP25|I'll Win With My Own Battle Style!!}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Norman Slaking Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Slaking in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] [[File:Norman Slaking Truant Adventures.png|thumb|left|200px|{{a|Truant}} activated]] Slaking first appeared in ''[[PS186|Brushing Past Breloom]]'', where {{adv|Norman}} sent him out when he sensed someone's presence. He then had Slaking use {{m|Swagger}} to {{status|Confusion|confuse}} the hiding individual and reveal them, but the person he had sensed, {{adv|Ruby}}, managed to protect himself with [[Kiki]]'s {{m|Safeguard}}. In ''[[PS209|Hanging Around With Slaking I]]'', Slaking was used to battle Ruby at the [[Weather Institute]], easily overpowering [[Nana]] and Kiki. After being attacked from [[Mumu]]'s {{m|Mud Shot}}, Norman had Slaking power up with {{m|Bulk Up}} and then rip out the stairs Ruby was standing in, holding them over an edge and keeping them stable while he talked to Ruby. In ''[[PS258|Rayquaza Redemption I]]'', Slaking was used alongside {{p|Spinda}} to help train {{adv|Wally}} at the [[Sky Pillar]], facing against Wally's {{p|Kecleon}} and {{p|Flygon}}. While Slaking was hampered by {{a|Truant}}, Wally had Kecleon use {{m|Astonish}} on Slaking while Flygon attacked with {{m|Sand Tomb}}. As a response, Norman had Spinda use {{m|Skill Swap}} to free Slaking from its Truant, allowing Norman to then defeat Wally with a combination of Slaking's {{m|Blizzard}} and Spinda's {{m|Teeter Dance}}. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|normal||Norman Slaking {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Swagger|1=Hyper Beam|2=Bulk Up|3=Blizzard}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Swagger|1=Hyper Beam|2=Bulk Up|3=Blizzard}}}} {{anmov|normal|Swagger|PS186|Brushing Past Breloom}} {{anmov|normal|Hyper Beam|PS209|Hanging Around With Slaking I}} {{anmov|fighting|Bulk Up|PS210|Hanging Around With Slaking II}} {{anmov|ice|Blizzard|PS258|Rayquaza Redemption I}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ==Trivia== * Slaking is the only Pokémon in [[Pokémon Adventures]] to have used the move {{m|Bulk Up}}. ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Slaking}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Slaking}} [[Category:Norman's Pokémon]] [[Category:Ruby and Sapphire characters]] [[Category:Emerald characters]] [[Category:Black 2 and White 2 characters]] [[Category:Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire characters]] [[Category:Pokémon belonging to Ash and friends' family]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters (Pokémon)]] [[Category:Ash & Pikachu characters]] [[es:Slaking de Norman]] [[it:Slaking di Norman]] [[zh:千里的请假王]]
